title: Hisaab shop file
description: The JSON that "Load shop" reads (pasted, chosen as a file, or the sample shop), checked by fromShopFile() in app.js. Text that does not start with { or [ is read as CSV instead and turned into this shape; see export-entries.csv.md. This schema describes a clean file. The reader is more lenient: a customer or entry that fails a rule is skipped and listed under "Skipped {n}: "; a repeated phone is kept once; an entry for an unknown phone adds that customer; a missing or unreadable date becomes today and is counted; a note is cut at 200 characters; an invalid upi is skipped and the saved UPI ID is kept. The load fails only when the text is not valid JSON, has no customers list, has an entries value that is not a list, or leaves nothing usable. Unknown properties are ignored. Loading replaces the open shop, with one Undo.

shop.description: Shop name, trimmed. If shop is missing or empty the validator tries shop_name, then name, then uses "My shop".

upi.description: UPI ID (VPA) for pay links, trimmed. Optional; if missing or empty, upi_id is tried, then the UPI ID already saved in the app is kept. A value must pass validUpi(): 2 to 256 letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens, then @, then a letter and 1 to 63 more letters or digits (for example shopname@okbank). A value that fails is listed under Skipped and the saved UPI ID is kept; the rest of the file still loads.

upi_id.description: Fallback for upi, with the same validUpi() check.

customers.description: Customers. May be empty when every customer appears in entries.

name.description: Display name, trimmed. Optional: an empty or missing name is replaced by the phone number. Other JSON types are converted to text.

phone.description: Indian mobile number. Every character that is not a digit is removed, then a leading 91 is dropped from 12 digits, or a leading 0 from 11; the result must be exactly 10 digits. A record whose phone fails is skipped. The first digit is not checked on a load.

name_hi.description: Optional name in Devanagari, kept when not empty. When absent the app shows a transliteration it works out itself.

name_te.description: Optional name in Telugu script, kept when not empty.

entries.description: Ledger entries, in any order. Optional: a file with customers and no entries key loads. The position in this list becomes the entry's seq, used to order entries that share a date.

phone.description: Indian mobile number. Every character that is not a digit is removed, then a leading 91 is dropped from 12 digits, or a leading 0 from 11; the result must be exactly 10 digits. A record whose phone fails is skipped. The first digit is not checked on a load.

type.description: credit (the shop gave goods on credit) or payment (the customer paid). Case and surrounding spaces are ignored. Also read as credit when the value starts with: debit, udhar, udhaar, sale, sales, sold, gave, given, purchase, baki, baaki, due. Also read as payment: paid, pay, jama, receipt, received, receive, recd, collected, got, repayment, repaid, deposit, settlement, settled. Anything else skips the entry.

amount.description: Rupees. A number is used as it is. In a string, commas and spaces are removed, then a leading Rs, INR, rupees or the rupee sign, and a trailing /-, Rs, INR, rupees or "only". The entry is skipped when the amount is missing, blank, not a number, below zero or above 1e12. An amount with paise is rounded to whole rupees, halves up, and the load message counts them.

date.description: Date of the entry. Kept when its first 10 characters are a valid YYYY-MM-DD (text after them is ignored), or when the whole value is day first, D/M/YYYY, with "/", "." or "-" between the parts (stored as YYYY-MM-DD). A missing or unreadable date is not an error: the entry gets today's date and the load message counts such entries. A date after today is accepted.

note.description: Short note. Optional. Longer text is cut to 200 characters, not rejected. Other JSON types are converted to text; a falsy value becomes "".

shot.description: Optional payment screenshot as a data URL. Left out when it does not start "data:image/" or is longer than 400,000 characters; the entry is kept and the load message counts the pictures left out.

name.description: Used only when this phone is not in customers: the new customer gets this name (or the phone when missing).

owner.description: Optional shop profile: owner name. Written by the backup file when set.

logo.description: Optional shop profile: logo as a data URL, accepted up to 60 KB.
